71:11.text: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,

71:12.text: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"

71:13.text: What is the matter with you, that
(from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness)

71:14.text: While He has created you in
[i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)]

71:15.text: See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?

71:16.text: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

71:17.text: And Allâh has brought you forth from the

71:18.text: Afterwards He will return you into it

71:19.text: And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

71:20.text: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

71:21.text: said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.

71:22.text: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.

71:23.text: "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’
(these are the names of their idols)

71:24.text: "And indeed they have led many astray. And

71:25.text: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allâh.

71:26.text: said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!

71:27.text: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.

71:28.text: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zâlimûn
grant You no increase but destruction!"
